author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have identified all five fundamental nucleobases—adenine, guanine, cytosine, thymine, and uracil—in samples from asteroid Ryugu. This finding suggests that the chemical precursors to life’s genetic code may have formed naturally in space, predating Earth’s own biology.

Source Article: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261102075903.htm#google_vignette
